messages:
Sam - AE: Heads-up: JadeProof wants a 10-day POC for a customer-fine-tuned 13B variant + embeddings. Requirements: streaming chat, embeddings, SAML SSO, HIPAA scope, and target ~100ms p50 per token. They plan to use customer-managed KMS.
Tara - Sales Eng: Do we know artifact/quant format? Any adapter/LoRA involved?
Sam - AE: They said safetensors with LoRA adapter + tokenizer.json; trainer exported nf4-q4.
Ben - ML Eng: nf4+LoRA common but needs validation. I'll run a quick compat sweep and simulate streaming.
Ben - ML Eng: Running: `compat-scan --input jadeproof_13b_safetensors.tar.gz --check-tokenizer --check-kv --simulate-stream`
DeployBot: Capacity probe: pool "poc-west-2" shows 3x A100 available for requested window. :white_check_mark:
Ben - ML Eng: Scan results: tokenizer loads but 9 OOV tokens -> we can map. Model loads but attention kernel mismatch at block 11; requires a small adapter shim. Estimated eng work: 24-48h for patch + 24h perf validations. Streaming p50 after fix estimated 90-110ms on A100 with tuned batching.
Tara - Sales Eng: Good to flag for timeline. Pricing idea for 10-day POC: $3,800 reserved (includes baseline GPU) + $0.65 per 1k tokens extra. Subject to change if adapter extends.
Rhea - Security: HIPAA requires Dedicated/Private + signed BAA/DPA before data ingest. BYOK supported on Private; need KMS ARN and key policy, and attestation of their controls. Will send short questionnaire + checklist.
Sam - AE: I'll request DPA/BAA + KMS ARN and ask them to return within 3 business days to keep schedule.
Ben - ML Eng: Opened ticket ENG-8432 for adapter shim, tokenizer mapping, and streaming regression tests. Will attach perf matrix and sample vectors. ETA patch 48h, validation 24h.
Tara - Sales Eng: Action items: Sam collects legal/sec docs; Rhea to send questionnaire; Ben to post ENG-8432 updates; I'll prepare provisional SOW and kickoff invite.
Sam - AE: I'll update JadeProof and paste replies here. Also adding: if nf4 fallback persists we can recommend a qint8 re-export; I'll note potential impact on latency/cost in the SOW. :memo:
